set.body:
From the S5.2 review (61cc2da). FilePresetStore.scala:95-96 uses Paths/user.home directly and ImportWizardHost uses JavaFX FileChooser and Files.readAllBytes, bypassing the S0.9 seams (Preferences[F], FileSystem[F].readStream, Dialogs.chooseOpen(FileKind)). Per-user preset scope is correct (presets describe an instrument/export convention; the document records the applied mapping).

Acceptance: after s09-portability lands, the preset store runs on Platform.preferences or Platform.files, the wizard's file choice on Platform.dialogs, and source reading on readStream; InMemoryPlatform-backed tests for presets; no direct java.nio/FileChooser in the wizard host. Optional: export a preset into the project.
set.title: Move import presets and wizard file access onto the S0.9 platform seams
